subject.title: Subagent announce give-up (retry-limit/expiry) does not wake parent waiting on sessions_yield → permanent deadlock

question: Should this issue be closed by landing the narrow parent-wake fix in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95080, or should it wait for a broader durable announce queue and retry/expiry configuration design?
rationale: The central deadlock is a concrete bug, but the issue also asks for new config surface and later comments raise durable transcript-repair concerns that require maintainer scope choice.

options.title: Land Narrow Wake Fix
options.body: Accept the bounded failed-delivery wake behavior, then track retry/expiry configurability and durable queue work separately.

options.title: Require Live Transport Proof First
options.body: Keep the issue open until a real Signal/Telegram-style run proves the parent wakes once without duplicate or misrouted delivery.

options.title: Hold For Durable Queue Design
options.body: Pause the narrow fix and resolve the broader persisted-announcement and tool-result pairing direction before closing this issue.

recommendation.title: Land Narrow Wake Fix
recommendation.body: Accept the bounded failed-delivery wake behavior, then track retry/expiry configurability and durable queue work separately.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent subagent lifecycle history and cross-cutting ownership make this the best available product-direction owner from the evidence.
